content.title: Alycia Baumgardner retains titles against Bo Mi Re Shin; Shadasia Green exits on stretcher in scary scene
content.text: Alycia Baumgardner has Katie Taylor and Amanda Serrano in her sights after retaining her world titles.Baumgardner (18-1, 7 KOs) defeated Bo Mi Re Shin (19-4-3, 9 KOs) by unanimous decision (98-92, 98-92, 99-91) on Friday night at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York to defend her unified WBA, IBF and WBO super featherweight belts.AdvertisementImmediately after, she called out two of the biggest stars on the women's side of the sport."Katie Taylor, Amanda Serrano — what's up?" Baumgardner said.Taylor, 39, and Serrano, 37, are both nearing the end of their storied careers, with Taylor angling for a swan song later this year at the Croke Park stadium in Dublin. Serrano has offered no concrete timeline for the end of her career, but is thought to also be in the final stages of a legacy-filled run in the sport that has spanned almost two decades.AdvertisementAlthough Taylor and Serrano are the biggest names in the women's side of the sport, fans haven't been calling for Baumgardner to face the future Hall of Famers as much as they have been parading for a bout between Baumgardner and unified lightweight champion Caroline Dubois."I'm a piranha, that's a guppy," Baumgardner said dismissively of Dubois. "Get her out of here."Baumgardner looked in total control through the first five rounds of Friday's fight. The American champion was far too sharp and accurate and limited Shin. Baumgardner rocked the challenger heavily in Round 4 with an uppercut, but couldn't finish the fight.AdvertisementShin had her best moments in the sixth round. It was in that frame that Baumgardner began to tire visibly, and Shin was able to force her into toe-to-toe exchanges where the Korean came off better. Shin repeated that success in Round 7, however Baumgardner managed to regain control of the fight in the final three rounds. She slowed down the pace and kept the contest at long range with plenty of movement, rather than standing and trading with Shin, which completely nullified the challenger.Baumgardner's display was better than Dubois' majority decision victory over Shin in 2023.AdvertisementIn the night's co-main event, Lani Daniels (12-4-2, 2 KOs) upset Shadasia Green (16-2, 11 KOs) to capture the IBF and WBO unified super middleweight titles. An unanswered and sustained barrage of shots from Daniels in the opening 30 seconds of Round 9 forced the referee to stop the bout.Green appeared to be unsteady when the contest was stopped. She immediately received medical attention and was worryingly stretchered out of the ring a few minutes later. It was later confirmed on the ESPN broadcast that she was conscious, speaking and moving.AdvertisementCheck out full Baumgardner vs. Shin results and highlights below, as well as Uncrowned's play-by-play of the main card.Main cardIBF, WBA and WBO Super Featherweight titles: Alycia Baumgardner def.
